description: Open a categorized, paginated emoji picker and type the selected emoji into the currently focused app.
capabilities: The launcher opens a category deck with favorites and emoji groups; long categories paginate automatically.
Tap an emoji to type it into the focused app. Double-tap types its shortcode when one is available; this addon does not copy emojis to the clipboard.
decks: emoji-selector-<category> — one generated deck per category, with page suffixes for longer categories
